title: Your $200 AI plan has a ceiling nobody priced
summary:
Flat AI plans hide the one number you need: how much work the meter lets through before it stops you.
API cost per task is measurable. Across 132 graded agent runs on a small repo (TinyDB, about 2k lines), a hard coding task cost about $0.12 on GPT-6.1 Sol at medium effort. At that rate, $200 of API buys roughly 1,660 hard tasks a month, around 79 per working day.
High effort roughly doubled the cost with no gain in pass rate. Across task mix and effort settings, break-even swings by more than 9
